mapper.select: /* selectMasterWmGrVmiEDIVPODT */ SELECT GR_QTY FROM EDIVPODT WHERE BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code} AND VPO_NO = #{VPO_NO} AND STATUS != 'D' AND RECV_FLAG != 'C' AND GR_QTY <> 0
mapper.update: UPDATE EDIVPODT SET RECV_FLAG = 'C', GR_QTY = IV_QTY, RECV_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, VGR_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') WHERE BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code} AND VPO_NO = #{VPO_NO}
mapper.select: SELECT BUYER, VPO_NO, VPO_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, ITEM_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AGENT, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ FROM EDIVPODT WHERE BUYER =#{st_warehouse_code} AND VPO_NO =#{VPO_NO}
